description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers of a model, with a threshold of $1 \times 10^{-3}$. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, while the y-axis shows the sparsity ratio, which measures the proportion of output values below the specified threshold. Three distinct lines are plotted: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before gating, with an average of 0.003; a dotted orange line showing the sparsity ratio after gating, averaging 0.126; and a solid green line indicating the sparsity ratio after applying average gating, with an average of 0.080. The dashed blue line remains nearly flat at a low value across all layers. The dotted orange line starts at a high sparsity ratio near 0.8 at layer 0 and declines sharply before stabilizing around 0.03 by layer 10, with some fluctuations afterward. The solid green line begins at approximately 0.3, decreases rapidly, and then stabilizes at a low level, similar to the blue line, indicating that average gating reduces sparsity significantly compared to raw gating.
